genre: Swipe-to-paint puzzle (maze fill, sequencing, gate unlocking)
title: Path Painter
audience: Puzzle players ages 12–45 seeking quick, satisfying brain-teasers with clean visuals and 1–3 minute sessions

controls.reasons: Minimal, intuitive gestures fit portrait casual play.
fail_safes: Undo button (1-step free; more via coins/rewarded).
Path auto-correct to nearest orthogonal direction.
touch_only: Swipe: Draw continuous path; finger follows grid-snapped cursor.
Tap: Toggle switches, confirm actions, start next level.
Hold: Preview path direction helper arrows (optional assist).
Two-finger drag: Pan during zoomed inspection (optional).

steps: Enter level: see maze, paintable tiles, gates, and hazards.
Plan: identify color order and gate dependencies.
Swipe to paint continuous paths; fill tiles and trigger switches.
Unlock gates by filling required tiles in correct color/sequence.
Complete objectives (fill %, color order, keys) within moves/time.
Earn stars based on completion/time/moves; collect coins; proceed.
core_loop.reasons: Classic loop with added sequencing layers, proven engagement.
core_loop.session: Play 3–5 levels in 5 minutes; watch optional rewarded ads for hints/undos/next-level boost.

usp: Color-gate sequencing adds planning beyond simple fill.
Zen feel with tactile paint and haptics; optional timer for intensity.
positioning.pitch: Satisfying swipe-to-paint mazes with color-sequencing and gate logic — quick levels, smart hazards, cozy polish.
positioning.reasons: Proven mechanic + layered hazards gives depth; strong fit for mobile sessions; feasible scope.

progression.xp: Player level increases with stars; grants small coin packs and cosmetics.
meta: Map progression with chapters; unlock next by earning stars or completing prior set.
Daily Puzzle: One handcrafted challenge; streak badge.
Cosmetic Brush Skins and Paint Trails unlocked via coins/stars.
Milestones grant boosters (Undo+, Slow Time, Ghost Path preview).
progression.reasons: Light meta keeps motivation without overcomplicating.

similar_apps.why: Swipe-to-paint filling tiles; satisfying completion visuals similar to the core mechanic.
similar_apps.name: Color Fill 3D

similar_apps.why: Guiding a colored trail through obstacles resonates with path painting satisfaction.
similar_apps.name: Line Color 3D

similar_apps.why: Maze-based paint filling via continuous movement; comparable swipe guidance.
similar_apps.name: Roller Splat!

similar_apps.why: Simple physics-free drawing puzzles with clear goals and short sessions, similar puzzle pacing and ad economy.
similar_apps.name: Happy Glass

similar_apps.why: Color-connection logic and sequencing feel, though mechanics differ; appeals to same audience.
similar_apps.name: Flow Free

sfx: Plink on tile fill; chord on combo gate unlock.
Toggle click, key chime, gentle fail thud.
UI pops and celebratory fanfare on completion.
vfx: Viscous paint trail with slight bloom and edge ripple.
Gate unlock sparkle and soft puff.
Haptic ticks on tile fill and gate open.
art_direction.music: Ambient, light marimba/synth pads; loops unobtrusively with success sting variations.
props: Switches (toggle pads), keys, bridges, one-way arrows, crumble tiles.
Paint sources (color wells) and mixers (for advanced levels).
characters: Brush cursor icon with subtle personality (eyes optional, abstract to avoid character violence).
environments: Clean, minimalist boards with soft-shaded tiles.
Cozy backdrops: paper, wood, canvas, pastel gradient themes.

sample_levels.objective: Open a single gate by painting its color.
sample_levels.win_condition: Fill the highlighted color tiles to open the gate and then fill remaining area.

sample_levels.objective: Use a switch to open path; simple sequence of two gates.
sample_levels.win_condition: Activate switch to open Gate A, paint through, then fill Gate B color tiles to open and finish.
lose_conditions: Trap self in dead-end requiring reset

sample_levels.objective: Follow color order: Red → Blue → Yellow; one-way tiles enforce routing.
sample_levels.win_condition: Open and pass gates in the specified order and fill 95% before timer ends.

sample_levels.objective: Complex multi-color dependencies with crumble tiles.
sample_levels.win_condition: Plan route to traverse crumble tiles once while unlocking all gates and reaching 100% fill.

level_structure.stars: 0–3 stars per level based on time/moves/optional bonus tiles.
level_structure.reasons: Gradual mechanic onboarding ensures comprehension and retention.
chapters: Chapter 1: Basics (single color fill, simple gates).
Chapter 3: Color Sequencing (ordered gates, paint sources).
Chapter 5: Hazards (spikes on timers, crumble tiles).
Chapter 6+: Remix with time trials and expert layouts.

ramp: Levels 1–10: Core painting, no fail states, no timers.
21–40: Sequenced gates and color sources; gentle timers.
41–60: One-way tiles, crumble floors, multi-gate dependencies.
61+: Combined mechanics; optional hard mode with tighter move caps.
assist: Hint path (first segment) via rewarded ad or coin spend.
Adaptive difficulty: If 3 fails, loosen timer or show tip.
difficulty_curve.reasons: Standard scaffolding with adaptive aids to reduce churn.

camera_orientation: Portrait, top-down orthographic view with slight parallax background; optional pinch to zoom during tutorial off by default.

market_opportunity.reasons: Benchmarks from similar hyper-casual/causal puzzle; success hinges on level variety and polish.
market_opportunity.analysis: High search interest for paint puzzles with moderate competition. Differentiation via sequencing gates, toggles, and multi-color logic can capture users seeking more than generic fills.

avoid: Copying specific levels or art styles from top paint-fill titles.
Overly long labyrinths that inflate session time.
competitor_contrast.reasons: Clear differentiation from simple area-fill by layering logic mechanics.
gaps_we_fill: Sequencing gates and toggles provide puzzle depth without complexity bloat.
Short, bite-sized levels with optional challenge modes and daily puzzles.
Strong accessibility (palette modes, patterns) and tactile feedback.

ads: Rewarded: +1 Hint, +1 Undo, +30s Time, Retry keep progress.
Interstitial: Every 2–3 level completions or on optional retry; suppressed for new users and after IAP remove-ads.
iap: Cosmetic Bundles (brush + trail + background). No gameplay advantage.
economy_monetization.reasons: Standard ad-supported puzzle economy with optional cosmetics.
currencies: Coins (soft): Earned from levels, ads, milestones; used for hints, undos, cosmetics.
No hard currency; light IAP packs sell coins and remove-ads.

technical_assumptions: Engine: Unity 2022 LTS, 2D URP for lightweight VFX.
Grid-based board using tilemap; pathfinding not required beyond simple occupancy checks.
Level data as JSON/ScriptableObjects; no online server required; daily puzzle bundled in app updates or generated locally.
Ad mediation via widely-used SDK (e.g., Google AdMob mediation).
IAP via Unity IAP with Google Play/App Store receipts.
Local save with cloud backup via platform services (optional).
60 FPS target; low-end device support (2GB RAM).
No user-generated content; no multiplayer; offline-first.
qa_acceptance_criteria: Controls: Swiping paints continuous orthogonal paths without diagonal leaks across 100 test attempts.
Collision: Paint cannot pass through closed gates; opens only upon meeting color/sequence conditions.
Undo/Reset: Undo reverses last continuous stroke; Reset clears board reliably.
Hints: Revealed path segments are valid and solvable; cannot soft-lock.
Timer: Timer accuracy within ±0.05s; Slow Time booster reduces speed by intended percentage.
Colorblind: Pattern overlays applied to paint, gates, and sources; all objectives readable without color.
Performance: Steady 55+ FPS on reference low-end Android device (e.g., 2019 2GB RAM).
Ads: Rewarded grants correct item; interstitials respect frequency caps and are removed after Remove Ads purchase.
IAP: Transactions succeed/fail gracefully; entitlements persist after reinstall via restore.
Progression: Star thresholds unlock chapters correctly; Daily Puzzle resets at local midnight.
Persistence: Exiting mid-level restores state or safely restarts without data loss as designed.
Privacy: Consent screen shown on first launch in relevant regions; analytics off until consent given.
Crash-free: <0.5% crash rate across test matrix.
Tutorial: All steps appear once and can be revisited via Help.
Localization: Text truncation/overflow does not occur in supported languages.
store_listing_strategy: ASO keywords: paint puzzle, color fill, maze puzzle, path painter. Icon: bold brush stroke forming a path through a gate with sparkles; high contrast and pattern details to signal accessibility. Screenshots: 1) Swipe to paint satisfying paths (with trail VFX), 2) Unlock gates in the right order (icons), 3) Outsmart switches and one-way tiles, 4) Quick levels, optional timers, 5) Daily puzzle and cozy themes. Video: 12–15s showcasing swipe, gate unlock chain, and completion splash. Soft launch in tier-2 English markets; iterate on first-time UX, level 1–20 funnel, ad frequency A/B. Feature colorblind toggle and pattern overlays in screenshots to highlight inclusivity.
